summary: Tested iteration 216v — Phase 3 Engineers Admin, Reorder Alerts, Quote PDF. All 21 backend tests pass (1 skipped). Frontend verified: Engineers tab in nav strip, Engineers Admin page with table/form/skill chips, PDF button in QuoteEditor footer. Backend PDF endpoint returns valid PDF with correct headers.
critical_code_review_comments: engineers_admin.py: Clean implementation with proper _require_admin() guard, _public() strips _id, open_jobs aggregation pipeline is efficient
EngineersAdminPage.js: All form fields have data-testid attributes, skill chips toggle correctly, error handling with toast notifications
BillingPage.js: PDF download button (data-testid='quote-download-pdf') correctly implemented with blob download pattern, only shows when quote exists
ServiceOpsShell.js: Engineers nav entry correctly positioned between Scheduler and Parts with HardHat icon
seed_data_creation: Created quote Q-00002 for case SVC-00006 to test PDF endpoint. PATCH test updated Master Admin engineer with TEST-216v-* values (mobile, vehicle_reg, sage_user_id, skills).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 features verified: (1) GET /api/svc/engineers returns engineers with open_jobs count, no _id leak, (2) POST/PATCH/DELETE engineers work with proper auth guards, (3) GET /api/svc/parts/reorder-alerts returns empty list (no parts with thresholds seeded), (4) GET /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/quote.pdf returns valid PDF with Content-Disposition header, (5) Frontend Engineers Admin page at /service-ops/engineers renders correctly with table, add form, skill chips, (6) PDF button in QuoteEditor footer only shows when quote exists.

backend_list_engineers.evidence: GET /api/svc/engineers returns {engineers:[...]} with open_jobs count, no _id leak

backend_create_engineer.evidence: POST /api/svc/engineers validates email exists in org (404 if not), returns 409 for duplicate

backend_create_engineer_auth.evidence: _require_admin() checks role in (owner, manager) or is_master_admin

backend_patch_engineer.evidence: PATCH /api/svc/engineers/{user_id} updates skills, mobile, vehicle_reg, sage_user_id

backend_reorder_alerts.evidence: GET /api/svc/parts/reorder-alerts returns {count, alerts:[...]} with correct structure

backend_quote_pdf.evidence: GET /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/quote.pdf returns 200 application/pdf with Content-Disposition attachment

frontend_engineers_nav.evidence: Engineers tab (HardHat icon) visible in nav strip between Scheduler and Parts

frontend_engineers_table.evidence: Table renders with columns: Name, Mobile, Vehicle, Skills, Sage, Open jobs, Status

frontend_engineers_add_form.evidence: Add engineer button opens form with email, full_name, mobile, vehicle, sage, skill chips

frontend_pdf_button.evidence: Customer PDF button (data-testid='quote-download-pdf') in QuoteEditor footer, triggers blob download

notes: The billing queue only shows cases with status in [closed, invoiced, awaiting_sign_off, repaired] AND cover_type=chargeable. Test case SVC-00006 has status=new so doesn't appear in billing queue UI, but the PDF endpoint was verified working via direct API call.
